authority: Design audit only; implementation follows independently accepted DESIGN_REVIEW; zero main or runtime mutations

rca_layers.L0_constitutional: Ingress accepts unauthenticated messages from arbitrary users into Zenoh cog bus; missing 2oo3 quorum on mutating actions; /tool currently passes None/False and halts closed
rca_layers.L1_atomic_data: tools/telegram_client.ml line 567 prints unredacted private message text to stdout; line 570 emits immediate optimistic reactions before downstream acceptance
rca_layers.L2_component_lifecycle: tools/telegram_client.ml lines 545-546 marks update processed and advances poll offset before verified downstream acceptance by Gleam/Zenoh, creating silent message loss on failure
rca_layers.L3_transaction_fencing: cognitive_worker /tool maps to dispatch_action_request with lease_opt: None and authority_verified: False, correctly rejecting caller-invented leases but lacking canonical direct read dispatch delegation
rca_layers.L4_system_bus: cognitive_worker line 2699 deletes shared Zenoh key indrajaal/l5/cog/intent/req via http_delete, racing concurrent intents and causing batch drop
rca_layers.L5_cognitive_routing: Informational commands (/start, /status, /doctor, /plan) work well, but /tool lacks bounded read dispatch integration with direct_read_dispatch
rca_layers.L6_ecosystem_api: BotAPI polling lacks chat/user allowlist enforcement at ingress; token and default chat loaded from DB/env without identity verification
rca_layers.L7_federation_symbiosis: Gleam must own authentication, dispatch, task binding, and delivery policy per SC-HARNESS-MCP-001; native IO acts as subordinate bounded transport
rca_layers.L8_delivery_ledger: No durable SQLite delivery ledger; outcomes are unacknowledged or subject to blind retries without idempotency keys
rca_layers.L9_meta_provenance: Reliance on synthetic test fixtures instead of verified canonical direct_read_dispatch and real BotAPI contract

trust_boundaries.untrusted_ingress: Internet Telegram BotAPI -> Ingress Adapter; strictly filtered by allowlist (allowed_chat_ids, allowed_user_ids) before parsing or publishing
trust_boundaries.cooperative_local_launcher: NAS-1 same-Unix-user (an) trusted service environment holding canonical task resource and coordinator lease for bounded operations
trust_boundaries.execution_authority: Operator chat identity is an authenticated user identity, not a Sa-plan lease. Bounded reads execute under service direct_read_dispatch; mutating tools require 2oo3 quorum and canonical task lease
trust_boundaries.delivery_ledger: Local SQLite ledger guarantees at-least-once durable intake before offset commit, and at-most-once delivery tracking with UNCERTAIN failure semantics

smallest_usable_production_design.component_1_ingress_guard: Gleam-owned telegram_ingress_guard.gleam enforcing chat/user allowlist and secret redaction before any bus publish
smallest_usable_production_design.component_2_durable_ledger: SQLite-backed telegram_delivery_ledger.gleam committing update_id offset only after durable inbox recording; tracks PENDING, DISPATCHED, DELIVERED, UNCERTAIN
smallest_usable_production_design.component_3_non_destructive_bus: Discrete intent keys or direct inbox polling; eliminate destructive http_delete of shared intent root
smallest_usable_production_design.component_4_bounded_tool_dispatch: Route /tool query_doctor and /tool query_saplan through verified direct_read_dispatch with strict {} args validation; refuse mutating tools requiring 2oo3 quorum
smallest_usable_production_design.component_5_command_preservation: All existing bot commands (/start, /help, /status, /doctor, /plan, /checklist) remain 100% functional and unregressed

acceptance_criteria: AC-01: Non-allowlisted chat/user rejected at ingress with zero bus publication and zero offset corruption
AC-02: Private payload text redacted from all operational logs and traces
AC-03: Telegram update offset advances only upon verified durable ledger storage
AC-04: /tool query_doctor and /tool query_saplan return authentic un-fabricated system status via direct_read_dispatch
AC-05: /tool <mutating_tool> fails closed with 2oo3 quorum and Sa-plan lease requirement
AC-06: Shared Zenoh request keys are never destructively wiped
AC-07: Outbound delivery failure is durably recorded as UNCERTAIN or FAILED, never false ACK
AC-08: Standard bot directives (/start, /help, /doctor, /status) preserve 100% existing functionality
falsifiers: F-01: Unauthorized sender update published to indrajaal/l5/cog/intent/req
F-02: /tool query_doctor with arguments executes or accepts arguments
F-03: /tool mutating action executes without 2oo3 quorum
F-04: Downstream failure loses un-persisted Telegram update while offset advanced
F-05: http_delete wipes unread messages on shared request key
rollback_plan: Preserve main base 83dca039; all work isolated in .uos-workspaces/agy-telegram-admission-20261001; revert change with jj undo or discard workspace branch
